biotools.summary: mrQA is an open-source tool for automatically assessing protocol compliance in MRI datasets, designed to identify and address inconsistencies in acquisition parameters. It supports standard dataset formats such as DICOM and BIDS, and aims to improve data quality and facilitate data pooling across multiple sites.
